subject: pharmacology
title: Cytotoxic Anticancer III: Antimetabolites, Methotrexate Leucovorin Rescue and Fluoropyrimidines

steps.tx: **Antimetabolites** are molecular impersonators: methotrexate impersonates folate, fluorouracil impersonates uracil, cytarabine and gemcitabine impersonate cytidine, mercaptopurine impersonates purines, and all kill in S phase where impersonation is cashed as broken DNA or starved nucleotide pools. Their schedules (infusions, daily oral years, high dose pulses with rescues) exploit phase specificity, and their antidotes and pharmacogenetic fences are the richest in cytotoxic practice.
steps.say: Antimetabolites forge the cell's currency and are spent in S phase; each forgery has its own antidote.

right.title: Shared grammar
points: Rescue and antidote traditions per agent

steps.tx: **Methotrexate** lives three dose lives from the immunology lesson (weekly milligrams in rheumatoid arthritis) to oncology grams per square metre in leukaemia, lymphoma and osteosarcoma, where high dose courses run only with hydration, urine alkalinisation (its crystals obstruct acidic tubules), timed drug levels, and **leucovorin** rescue dosed by nomogram from those levels. Intrathecal methotrexate guards CNS sanctuaries and bills chemical arachnoiditis and leukoencephalopathy.
steps.say: High dose methotrexate is a level guided performance; leucovorin waits in the wings with a nomogram.

steps.tx: **Methotrexate** lives three dose lives, from weekly milligrams in rheumatoid arthritis to grams per square metre in leukaemia, lymphoma, and osteosarcoma. High dose courses run only with hydration, alkaline urine because crystals obstruct acidic tubules, timed drug levels, and leucovorin rescue chosen from a nomogram of those levels. Intrathecal methotrexate covers central nervous system sanctuaries that intravenous drug may miss. That route can bill chemical arachnoiditis and leukoencephalopathy. The nomogram is how the rescue dose is chosen, not an optional chart beside the infusion.
steps.say: High dose methotrexate for leukaemia, lymphoma, or osteosarcoma needs hydration, alkaline urine, timed levels, and leucovorin read from a nomogram. Crystals form if the urine stays acidic. Doses into the spinal fluid protect brain sanctuaries but can inflame the meninges and injure white matter.

vis.alt: A nomogram plots methotrexate levels over time and marks the leucovorin rescue doses those levels require.
vis.caption: Timed plasma concentrations are plotted so the rescue dose of folinic acid can be read from the curve rather than guessed. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Leucovorin** (folinic acid, 5 formyl tetrahydrofolate) rescues by refilling reduced folate pools downstream of dihydrofolate reductase, preferentially rescuing normal tissue when timed after methotrexate's tumour exposure, and in a second career potentiates fluorouracil (from the next lesson's family) by stabilising its thymidylate synthase complex. When methotrexate clearance collapses (renal failure), glucarpidase, a bacterial enzyme that cleaves methotrexate in blood, is the emergency exit.
steps.say: Leucovorin refills folate past the blockade; glucarpidase is the fire axe when kidneys fail.

steps.tx: **Leucovorin**, which is folinic acid or 5 formyl tetrahydrofolate, rescues cells by refilling reduced folate pools downstream of dihydrofolate reductase. Given after the tumour has been exposed to methotrexate, it preferentially saves normal tissue. In a second job it potentiates fluorouracil by stabilising the drug's complex with thymidylate synthase. When methotrexate clearance collapses because of renal failure, glucarpidase, a bacterial enzyme that cleaves methotrexate in the blood, is the emergency exit. The bypass does not switch the blocked enzyme back on.
steps.say: Leucovorin restores reduced folate beyond the dihydrofolate reductase block, so normal cells recover after methotrexate has had time to affect the tumour. It also stabilises the complex that makes fluorouracil more active. If the kidneys fail and methotrexate lingers, glucarpidase cuts the drug up in the bloodstream.

vis.alt: A folate pathway shows dihydrofolate reductase blocked and a folinic acid bypass refilling tetrahydrofolate beyond the block.
vis.caption: Methotrexate stops dihydrofolate reductase while leucovorin replenishes reduced folate downstream of that enzyme. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Pemetrexed**, methotrexate's multitargeted descendant (thymidylate synthase, DHFR and purine synthesis enzymes), treats mesothelioma and lung adenocarcinoma only under folate and B12 supplementation that disarmed its early marrow and gut mortality, a supplementation mandate written on every prescription. Its rash yields to dexamethasone premedication, and renal clearance fences dosing as the parent drug taught.
steps.say: Pemetrexed only became safe when vitamins were prescribed with it; supplementation is part of the drug.

left.title: Pemetrexed territory
points: Non squamous lung cancer therapy and maintenance

right.title: Mandatory partners
points: Folic acid daily from before cycle one

steps.tx: **Mercaptopurine** maintains childhood leukaemia remissions for years of nightly tablets, metabolised by thiopurine methyltransferase (TPMT, from the pharmacogenetic canon: deficiency converts standard doses into marrow catastrophes, testing or dose empiricism mandatory) and xanthine oxidase, so allopurinol co therapy demands mercaptopurine dose cuts of two thirds. Azathioprine shares the pathway from the immunology lesson, one metabolism governing three wards.
steps.say: TPMT decides mercaptopurine's dose; allopurinol rewrites it; one pathway, three wards again.

right.title: Interaction arithmetic
points: Allopurinol or febuxostat: cut dose by two thirds
Live vaccines fenced in maintenance immunosuppression

steps.tx: **Cytarabine** (ara C) is leukaemia's S phase scalpel: standard dose consolidation in AML, high dose courses billing cerebellar toxicity (finger nose testing before each dose in older patients), conjunctivitis prevented by steroid eye drops, and hand foot and neurotoxicity ceilings, while gemcitabine (its pancreatic and lung cousin) bills flu like fevers, oedema and rare pulmonary and haemolytic uraemic syndromes behind a gentler reputation.
steps.say: High dose cytarabine examines the cerebellum before each dose; the eyes get steroid drops by routine.

right.title: Gemcitabine signatures
points: Pancreatic, lung, bladder and breast regimens

steps.tx: **Hydroxyurea**, the ribonucleotide reductase inhibitor from the haematology lessons (sickle cell HbF induction, myeloproliferative cytoreduction), and fludarabine and cladribine (purine analogues whose lymphocyte specificity treats CLL and hairy cell leukaemia while billing years of cellular immunosuppression and PJP prophylaxis) complete the antimetabolite shelf examiners stock. Each drug's immune shadow outlasts its marrow shadow by years.
steps.say: Purine analogues suppress lymphocytes for years; prophylaxis calendars outlive chemotherapy calendars.

left.title: Hydroxyurea
points: Leg ulcers and skin cancers on long use

right.title: Fludarabine and cladribine
points: CLL and hairy cell leukaemia respectively
Irradiated blood products (graft versus host risk)

steps.tx: **Methotrexate interactions** deserves the final step because it kills quietly: NSAIDs and penicillins impair its renal excretion, trimethoprim adds antifolate blockade (pancytopenia in case reports that read like warnings), proton pump inhibitors delay high dose clearance, and alcohol and leflunomide share its liver. Every medication reconciliation before methotrexate, weekly or high dose, is this web read aloud.
steps.say: Methotrexate deaths are usually interaction deaths; reconcile the chart before every dose.
